name: Spatial457 v4 — L5 6D Spatial
protocol: Spatial457 arXiv-v4 L5 6D Spatial 1,837-question subset, VLMEvalKit exact accuracy; other levels excluded.

explanation.en: Exact-choice accuracy on the fixed Level-5 6D Spatial subset through VLMEvalKit.
explanation.zh: 通过 VLMEvalKit 在固定 Level-5 6D Spatial subset 上计算精确选择准确率。

summary.en: Spatial457 L5 evaluates six-dimensional spatial reasoning over synthetic 3D scenes.
summary.zh: Spatial457 L5 使用合成三维场景评估六维空间推理。

task_format.en: Answer 1,837 five-choice questions grounded in 1,000 synthetic 3D scenes.
task_format.zh: 回答基于 1,000 个合成三维场景的 1,837 道五选一问题。
